caption: The drawing features a symmetrical floral design with stylized flowers and leaves arranged vertically. At the top center, there is a large, fan-shaped flower with yellow petals outlined in blue, a red central area, and small red dots along the blue edges. Below this, a blue stem with multiple curved branches extends downward, holding various flowers and leaves. There are two red tulip-shaped flowers with yellow accents, one on each side at mid-height, and two blue tulip-shaped flowers with yellow accents, one on each side slightly lower. The blue stem and branches are decorated with small blue leaves. At the base of the drawing is a wide, semicircular blue shape with jagged upper edges, containing a yellow arc and three red triangles arranged in a row within the arc. The background is plain and off-white, and the design uses a limited color palette of blue, red, yellow, and off-white. At the bottom, the text "FROM A BOX 1777" is printed, indicating the source and year of the design.
title: Plate 1: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
